annotations.title: Screen a company against sanctions lists

description:
Screen a company's own names against sanctions lists: EU Financial Sanctions File, UK Sanctions List, OFAC SDN list, France's registre des gels.
Use it as the sanctions-list step of onboarding a supplier or customer (not full KYB). Don't use it to identify a company: call resolve_company or lookup_company first.
Inputs: country and identifier, as lookup_company (e.g. 'FR', '441639465').
Returns: result 'possible_match' (list, entry, score, reasons, listing date, legal act, official link), 'no_match_found' or 'not_checked', the list versions, and a note.
Limits: 2 units; API key required. A possible match is not proof; no match is never 'clear'. Read-only.

country.description: ISO country code: FR or ES or GB.
country.title: Country

identifier.description: Official ID, as lookup_company: FR SIREN (9 digits), SIRET or VAT; ES Registro Mercantil sheet, e.g. VI-23266. GB: Companies House company number, e.g. 00445790.
identifier.title: Identifier

name: screen_company

outputSchema.description: resolve_company and explain_match (brief 007 P1.7): the service's answer as is.
outputSchema.title: GraphOutput
